billing_and_database.note: PGlite runs the custom migration with stub Supabase auth roles. Tests cover RLS, event transactions, duplicates, ordering, retry, checkout leases, account deletion guards, and official SDK webhook signatures. It does not prove Supabase service behavior or multi-connection locking.

dependency_audit.note: Dated registry advisory evidence, not proof that dependencies contain no security flaws.

browser_tests.limits: Emulation and automated axe checks are not physical-device, full accessibility, or real-user validation.

screenshots.note: Revised desktop/phone workspace and billing reviewed. Additional audit checks desktop, tablet, 390px phone, 200% text at 320px, form descriptions, touch targets and a 390x360 viewport. A constrained viewport is not a physical virtual-keyboard test.

launch_configuration_guard.note: Unconfigured production setup is rejected; no secret values printed.

app_creation.note: Fresh copy verified product/brief naming, preserved license and lockfile, shared instructions/modules, generated environment defaults and output/dependency exclusions. Reusing an existing destination is rejected. The new copy also installed successfully with --frozen-lockfile.
